name: Export modal multi-format pipeline validates PNG, Animated, Spritesheet, Vector, and Game Shaders
description: Verify drawing a solid colored ball, opening the Export modal, navigating across format tabs (PNG, Animated, Sprite Sheet, Replay, Vector SVG, Game Shaders, Project), and configuring scaling and metadata.

planSteps.description: Select the Ellipse tool (press O), ensure shape mode in context bar is 'Shape: Filled Solid', press down on canvas, drag diagonally for at least 150 pixels, and release to draw a prominent circle
Select Flood Fill (press G), select a color, and click inside the circle to solidly color it
Click the 'Export' button in the top header
Verify the Export modal opens displaying the export tabs: PNG, Animated, Sprite Sheet, Replay, Vector SVG, Game Shaders, and Project
Click the 'PNG' tab and select 4x upscale multiplier
Verify the calculated resolution displays 4x larger than the base canvas
Verify the animated format selector shows GIF, APNG, WebM, and MP4 options
Verify the spritesheet grid parameters appear with column and spacing controls
Verify shader engine options appear for Godot 4.x, Unity URP, and GLSL Palette Cycle loops
Click the close button on the Export modal
Verify the Export modal is dismissed cleanly
